column3: Select one real mesh workload where tiny specialists plus router/abstain can replace or assist an existing path; define the user-facing decision, baseline, success/failure metrics, safety boundary, and a reproducible pilot artifact. Do not claim usefulness from toy benchmarks.

Implement the smallest reversible pilot in /home/mesh-home/tiny-fleet for the selected real workload, preserving operator-first routing and abstention; capture raw inputs, baseline/pilot outputs, resource cost, and failure cases in repository-local artifacts.

Independently verify the real pilot artifacts, baseline comparison, abstention/safety behavior, resource measurements, and reproducibility; publish a PASS, BLOCKED, or FAIL verdict without promoting unsupported generalization.
